title: Whycraft
description: Whycraft is an custom smp with a karma system, become a paragon or an outlaw and be chosen my 2 legendary swords if you are good or evil enough.
body: WhyCraft is a comprehensive Minecraft server featuring WCMMO skills, weapon mastery, distance mob scaling, boss fights, reputation system, rewards economy with sparks, auction house, parties, legendary artifacts, and extensive PvP/combat mechanics.
